WITH starts AS (
  SELECT timestamp AS start_time
  FROM process_metrics
  WHERE station_name = 'ced_station'
    AND metric_name = 'upstream_waiting_time'
),

ends AS (
  SELECT timestamp AS end_time
  FROM process_metrics
  WHERE station_name = 'ced_station'
    AND metric_name = 'exit_stopper_raising_time'
),

cycle AS (
  SELECT
    s.start_time,
    MIN(e.end_time) AS end_time
  FROM starts s
  JOIN ends e
    ON e.end_time > s.start_time
  GROUP BY s.start_time
),

selected_cycle AS (
  SELECT *
  FROM cycle
  WHERE start_time <= CAST(NULLIF('${anomaly_time}', '') AS timestamptz)
    AND end_time >= CAST(NULLIF('${anomaly_time}', '') AS timestamptz)
  LIMIT 1
)

SELECT
  p.timestamp AS time,
  p.metric_name,
  p.value
FROM process_metrics p
JOIN selected_cycle c
  ON p.timestamp BETWEEN c.start_time AND c.end_time
WHERE p.station_name = 'ced_station'
ORDER BY p.timestamp, p.metric_name;

WITH starts AS (
  SELECT timestamp AS start_time
  FROM process_metrics
  WHERE station_name = 'ced_station'
    AND metric_name = 'upstream_waiting_time'
),

ends AS (
  SELECT timestamp AS end_time
  FROM process_metrics
  WHERE station_name = 'ced_station'
    AND metric_name = 'exit_stopper_raising_time'
),

cycle AS (
  SELECT
    s.start_time,
    MIN(e.end_time) AS end_time
  FROM starts s
  JOIN ends e
    ON e.end_time > s.start_time
  GROUP BY s.start_time
),

selected_cycle AS (
  SELECT *
  FROM cycle
  ORDER BY ABS(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (
    start_time - CAST(NULLIF('${anomaly_time}', '') AS timestamptz)
  )))
  LIMIT 1
)

SELECT
  p.timestamp AS time,
  p.metric_name,
  p.value
FROM process_metrics p
JOIN selected_cycle c
  ON p.timestamp BETWEEN c.start_time AND c.end_time
WHERE p.station_name = 'ced_station'
ORDER BY p.timestamp, p.metric_name;
